findings.text: f_5.7: the left half is flat near-black for one frame (5.70 s, measured frame by frame: dark share 0.88 on that frame only, 0.25 on its neighbours) at the leading edge of the horizontal blur whip from the sofa to the skeleton office. Lead the wipe with the incoming plate.
Hook counter lands on $195,000 by 'news from', before he says the figure; land the count on his '$195,000'.
Captions fade in grey: 'OUT' (f_0.5) and 'FROM' (hook_2.0) are pale for their first frames; QC's reader fails page 0 (captions.ocr, captions.render).
Sofa cash plays from the start of its beat: pouring on 'and a chatbot beat them', settled by 'missing money'.
Skeleton plays from the start of its beat: already on the floor before 'skeletons'; its skull sits behind the mint card and wordmark at f_7.5.
hook_8.1: the frame, the $195,000 panel included, is motion-blurred as the strike lands on 'fraction'.
motion.cue_sync face-4: the caption page turns 3 frames before the CHATBOT slam (QC's numbers).
A small mint and coral fleck shows through the middle of every slam word (the burst slips).
title_9.5: the faded previous caption line sits above the next page on a graphics beat; the real-page card is left of centre and its standfirst and byline are under 30 px.
